description: Thank-you note with send-by date — Write a specific thank-you note (interview, donor, customer, referral, gift or general; kind is inferred) plus a short card/text version. Offline: send-by date (interview = next business day, customer/referral = 2 business days, US federal holidays skipped), how many of your details it uses, cliches and length for the kind. Params: occasion (required), details, from, kind, date (YYYY-MM-DD of the event, default today). Price: $0.005 USDC (Base, via x402).

occasion.description: e.g. interview for data analyst role at Acme with Priya Shah
